name: 16to1_48V_3V_10A_duty10_v90
note: GOAL problem v90 (11/11): 48 V -> 3 V (16:1) at 10 A (30 W), the 48 V-bus-to-point-of-load class (data-centre / telecom), duty window [duty_min, 1-duty_min] (a plain buck needs D = 0.0625 and fails). Bench: fsw 500 kHz, L 2.2 uH, flying C 47 uF, Cout 47 uF, Ron 5 mOhm (100 V GaN class), inductor DCR 2 mOhm (total copper fixed: n inductors -> n x DCR each), ESR 2 mOhm; no switching loss model. rating_max 60 V = top of the standard 48 V bus range (40-60 V), enforced in the search and by the judge. Textbook bar sc2_buck (9 devices): all 4 corners, D = 0.128, 24 V switch stress. v80 ran 400 V -> 25 V; numbers are NOT comparable. Settling 2000 periods (bench default): 500 changed feasibility for 2/40 library circuits (11/11 check). bar_eff 97.475 = sc2_buck median over 4 corners measured on this bench (judge_sys uses the measured reference value).
